patch.title: First Night Boston 2027 — New Year’s Eve Celebration
patch.description: Boston’s free First Night celebration welcomes 2027 on December 31, 2026, with Copley Square as its announced hub. The new edition’s performer schedule is still pending.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: Current operator page says Countdown to 2027, Copley Square, and entirely free and open to all. New Year’s Eve is December 31, 2026; the page’s separately labelled 2026 performers are not the 2027 lineup. Replaces an unsupported month-long placeholder.
patch.address: Copley Square, Boston, MA, United States
patch.longFormSummary:
• The current operator announces a free New Year’s Eve celebration welcoming 2027, with Copley Square as the hub. No purchase is required.
  • This pin is dated December 31, 2026. Detailed programming and exact times for the new edition remain to be confirmed; the website’s explicitly labelled 2026 performer list is not carried forward.

note: Corrected month-long placeholder and stale City Hall hub from current 2027 operator page; no inferred map coordinates.

patch.title: 2026 BMW Dallas Marathon Festival — December 11–13
patch.description: The 2026 BMW Dallas Marathon festival runs December 11–13 in Dallas; the marathon itself is on Sunday, December 13. Registration options and entry prices depend on the race.
patch.dateConfidenceReasoning: The current operator homepage explicitly publishes 2026 BMW Dallas Marathon December 11–13. This covers the festival, not a three-day marathon; end is exclusive.
patch.longFormSummary:
• The official 2026 festival runs December 11–13, replacing the prior month-long placeholder.
  • The marathon is the Sunday event, December 13. Other weekend races have separate distances, registration and eligibility; no single entry price or inventory claim is applied to the whole weekend.

note: Official festival dates replace December placeholder; inclusive end converted to exclusive December 14.
